name: Text Transform
author: TheRock892
description: Replace highlighted text with UPPERCASE, lowercase, or Capitalize from a small on-screen picker

barWidget.description: Opens the text case picker (UPPERCASE, lowercase, Capitalize). Right-click to change the keyboard shortcut.

schema.label: Keyboard shortcut
schema.description: Global hotkey that opens the picker, as MOD + MOD + KEY (e.g. "SUPER + SHIFT + U"). Applied live with hyprctl; leave empty to not bind one.
